==============================================
           SuppliesPro - CHANGELOG
        Update History & Release Notes
==============================================

This file tracks all updates made to the system.
Record each update with date, changes, and any issues.


HOW TO USE
==========
1. Updates are recorded automatically by update.bat/update.sh
2. Manual updates should be documented here
3. Include: date, changes, issues, rollback notes


UPDATE FORMAT
============
==============================================
Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM
==============================================
- Description of changes
- Database backup: backup_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.sqlite3
- Files modified: list here
- Issues: any problems encountered
- Notes: additional information


EXAMPLE
========
==============================================
Update: 2024-01-15 14:30
==============================================
- Added color field to Supply model
- Database backed up: backup_pre_update_2024-01-15_14.sqlite3
- Files modified: inventory/models.py
- Issues: None
- Notes: Field added successfully


VERSION HISTORY
===============

--- v1.0 Initial Release ---
Date: 2024-01-01

Features:
- Track printer supplies and stock levels
- Manage printers with IP addresses
- Install/dispose supplies on printers
- Record deliveries and update inventory
- View reports and analytics
- User management with roles (Admin, Manager, Staff)
- Database backup and restore
- Collapsible sidebar menu sections
- Reports: inventory, replenishment, consumption

Scripts:
- install.bat / install.sh - Create venv and install dependencies
- setup.bat / setup.sh - Initialize database
- start.bat / start.sh - Run development server
- run_production.bat / run_production.sh - Run production server (Waitress)
- update.bat / update.sh - Update with automatic backup

Default Login:
- Username: admin
- Password: admin123
